A '''Makebian Skybulb'''<ref name="GS">{{TORcite|exp=strongholds|type=item|Makebian Skybulb Arrangement|Starfighter & PvP Decoration Vendor}}</ref> was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]].<ref name="RotHC" />

{{Flora-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Makebian Skybulbs first appeared in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], a [[2013]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="RotHC" /> They were first identified in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds|''Galactic Strongholds'']], a [[2014]] expansion to the video game.<ref name="GS" />
